objective: Close Wave 3 A5: the cloud boundary must enforce memory scopes/localOnly, redact immediately before request construction, and audit provider class without payload.

criteria.promise: Requests carrying confidential or B2/B3 Brain context cannot be built for cloud providers unless policy explicitly allows it; localOnly is enforced at the final request boundary.
Cloud-bound request bodies redact credential-looking content immediately before serialization, while local providers keep original text because it never leaves the Mac.
Privacy audit events record metadata only: provider ID/class, sensitivity, Brain context level, localOnly, and redaction flags; no prompt/system payload is stored.

verification_gates.procedure: Inspect IntelligenceClient.build and IntelligenceTests; run focused Intelligence/Privacy/SecretGuard tests.
verification_gates.expected: Local-only and long-term Brain context block cloud at request construction.

verification_gates.procedure: Inspect serialized request fixtures for cloud/local providers.
verification_gates.expected: Cloud payloads are redacted; local payloads preserve original text.

verification_gates.procedure: Inspect audit event shape and tests.
verification_gates.expected: Audit contains only metadata and boolean redaction flags.

recon_evidence: IntelligenceClient.build, BELPrivacyAuditEvent, SecretGuard, and IntelligenceTests were inspected. Existing tests cover localOnly, B3 cloud refusal, cloud redaction, local preservation, and metadata audit; this ticket closes any remaining contract gaps.

first_checkpoint.evidence: Request-boundary fixture matrix for local/cloud, localOnly, B2/B3, and audit payload absence.
